idea-plugin.name: Blackboard
idea-plugin.description:
A quick, project-specific Markdown scratchpad that lives right inside your JetBrains IDE. Keep TODOs, debugging notes, snippets, links and half-formed ideas next to the code they belong to, without switching to a separate notes app.

Features

  • One note per project — each project has its own Blackboard, stored as a plain blackboard.md file in the project's .idea folder.
  • Always at hand — a tool window on the right: open it, write, close it and keep coding. Your text and caret position are exactly where you left them.
  • Automatic saving — no Save button: changes are written after a second of idle time, at least every few seconds while you type, and when the project closes.
  • Your notes are safe — atomic file writes, a save status line with Retry, a notification if saving fails, and a warning when the file is changed outside the IDE.
  • Markdown editor — syntax highlighting via the bundled Markdown plugin (falls back to plain text if it is disabled).
  • Native look — follows your IDE theme and editor font, no custom colors.

Works in IntelliJ IDEA, PyCharm, WebStorm, Rider, CLion, GoLand, PhpStorm, RubyMine and other IntelliJ-based IDEs, version 2026.2 and newer.

Getting started

Click the Blackboard button on the right tool window bar or use View | Tool Windows | Blackboard. The Toggle Blackboard action (Alt+B by default) opens the note ready for typing and hides it again, returning you to your code.
